A codec is a mechanism or process for encoding/decoding data. An algorithm is a computational procedure. These are different categories — a codec IMPLEMENTS algorithms but is not itself an algorithm type. INSTANCE_OF is the wrong relation. Frequency is a fundamental physical concept — it is a property/parameter that pitch estimation operates ON, not something pitch estimation depends on operationally. Remove the concept of frequency from the taxonomy and pitch estimation as a technique for determining fundamental frequency would still have a well-defined operating principle. This is 'operates on' not 'depends on per Law 8b'.

payload.name: microphone
payload.scope: human-made transducer built to convert acoustic pressure into electrical signals and persist as a manufactured device class

payload.body: Microphone is a transducer that converts acoustic pressure variations into electrical signals via a diaphragm and transducer element, parameterized by sensitivity, frequency response, polar pattern, impedance, and power requirement, persisting through manufactured units and design specifications replicated across production. [formal: instrument | substrate: matter | horizon: as-long-as-us | explicit: yes | epoch: 0.12]

payload.note: Acoustic measurement requires a transducer to capture sound pressure; remove microphone and the measurement cannot be performed as an operational procedure — the measurement stops operating without the capture device.

payload.reasoning: Acoustic measurement as an operational procedure requires a transducer to capture sound pressure. Remove the microphone and the measurement cannot be performed; the procedure stops operating. The removal test is satisfied, not merely a conceptual dependence.

Sample-rate conversion is a specific DSP technique, a kind of signal processing. The edge claims a dependency, but the removal test fails: signal processing as a discipline does not need to be 'removed' for SRC to operate; SRC is an instance of signal processing, not something that needs the field to function. The correct relation is INSTANCE_OF, not DEPENDS_ON.

Pre-emphasis is a filtering technique that is a specific instance of signal processing. It does not depend on the abstract field to operate; it is a kind of signal processing. The note confuses kind with need. Correct relation is INSTANCE_OF.

Microphone is a human-made transducer class built to convert acoustic pressure into electrical signals and persist as manufactured devices. Scope is clear made-side, parameters carve the class. Entry is sound.

payload.note: Phase unwrapping is a specific signal-processing technique for recovering continuous phase from wrapped measurements. It is a concrete method within signal processing.
Phase unwrapping is maintained as a technique to recover continuous phase for phase vocoder processing. Its designed purpose is to enable vocoder operations that require unwrapped phase.

payload.reasoning: jitter-buffer does not depend on buffer-underrun. A jitter buffer absorbs timing variations to prevent audio dropouts; buffer-underrun is what it tries to avoid, not a prerequisite for its operation. Remove buffer-underrun and jitter-buffers still operate — they just won't ever trigger an underrun condition. The relationship is preventive, not dependent.

Phase unwrapping is a specific signal-processing technique. It recovers continuous phase from wrapped measurements, which is a standard operation within signal processing. A competent speaker would call phase unwrapping a kind of signal processing technique.

Phase unwrapping serves phase-vocoder: the phase vocoder requires continuous (unwrapped) phase information to perform pitch shifting and time stretching accurately. Phase unwrapping is a designed prerequisite step in the phase vocoder pipeline, making the SERVES relationship correct.

Acoustic measurement does not specifically depend on microphones. It can use other transducers (pressure sensors, laser vibrometers, interferometers). The removal test fails: remove microphones and acoustic measurement still operates via other devices. A more accurate edge would be acoustic-measurement DEPENDS_ON measurement-instrument or INSTANCE_OF measurement.

payload.note: Latency compensation in audio systems operates by adjusting buffer size to accommodate timing variations. Remove buffer-size as a parameter and the latency compensation mechanism ceases to function — there is no buffer size to adjust.

Room modes are acoustic phenomena identified and characterized through acoustic measurement. Remove acoustic measurement and room modes cannot be determined — the concept of room-mode as a measurable entity depends on the measurement practice.

payload.name: digital-audio
payload.scope: human-made signal encoding method built to persist as the standard format for storing and transmitting audio as discrete numerical samples

payload.body: Digital audio is a representation of sound as a sequence of numerical samples, each encoding amplitude at a specific point in time. It is parameterized by sample rate (samples per second), bit depth (amplitude resolution per sample), and channel count (independent audio streams). The persistence mechanism is storage as binary data on digital media — files, streams, or memory buffers — where the numerical values are preserved exactly and can be reconstructed into acoustic waveforms through a digital-to-analog converter. [formal: digital-audio | substrate: mind | horizon: hours | explicit: yes | epoch: 0.01]

payload.note: Bit depth is a core parameter of digital audio that determines amplitude resolution per sample. Remove digital audio and bit depth as an audio specification has no meaning — it only exists as a property of the digital audio encoding format.

Noise floor in digital audio is determined by quantization limits set by bit depth. Remove digital audio and the concept of a digital noise floor vanishes — noise floor as a quantifiable property of the audio encoding depends on the digital representation.

payload.reasoning: Latency compensation in audio operates by adjusting buffer size to compensate timing drift. Remove buffer-size as a parameter and the compensation mechanism has no parameter to adjust — the operation ceases. This is a constitutive parameter dependency, not a meta-level claim.

Room modes are acoustic phenomena that exist independently of measurement. The note argues 'remove acoustic measurement and room modes cannot be determined' — but determining them is not operating them. This is a meta-level claim about knowing the concept (Law 2b), not about the phenomenon ceasing to operate. Room modes operate without being measured.

Bit depth is a parameter whose value and meaning only exist within the digital audio framework. Remove digital audio and bit depth has no operational substrate — there are no samples to resolve amplitude. This is a constitutive parameter-to-system dependency.

The note argues specifically about 'digital noise floor' but the source entry 'noise-floor' is a general concept encompassing analog noise floors too. Remove digital-audio and the analog noise floor concept still operates. The edge conflates a specific subclass with the general entry, failing the removal test for the full scope of noise-floor.

Phase unwrapping is a technique within signal processing, not a kind of signal processing itself. Signal processing is a broad field/discipline — Law 9a: 'a topic is not an instance of its discipline.' Phase unwrapping uses signal processing; it is not itself an instance of the field. If anything it IS signal processing (identity), which files nothing as DEPENDS_ON.

Phase unwrapping is designed and maintained to feed unwrapped phase data into phase vocoder processing. Its purpose is constitutive to the vocoder's operation — the vocoder requires continuous phase which only unwrapping provides. This is a clear teleological SERVES relation: the servant (unwrapping) points at the master (vocoder).

Acoustic measurement can be performed with optical, mechanical, or other transducer types — removing microphones does not make acoustic measurement cease operating. The note claims 'requires a transducer' but microphone is one transducer type, not the constitutive mechanism. This fails the removal test.

Pre-emphasis IS a signal processing technique — identity is not dependency (Law 8c). The note argues removal of signal processing framework stops pre-emphasis, but that confuses kind-membership with constitutive need. Pre-emphasis is a kind of signal processing, not dependent on it. If the edge is true, it should be INSTANCE_OF, not DEPENDS_ON.

Sample rate conversion IS a signal processing technique — same issue as pre-emphasis. Identity is not dependency (Law 8c). SRC is a kind of signal processing, not dependent on it. The removal of the broader category would eliminate SRC by definition, but that's identity not constitutive dependency. Should be INSTANCE_OF if anything.

Scope correctly identifies microphone as a human-made transducer converting acoustic pressure to electrical signals. Valid manufactured device class entry.

Scope correctly identifies phase unwrapping as a human-made signal-processing technique for recovering continuous phase from wrapped measurements, codified in DSP literature. Valid entry with persistence mechanism noted.

Definition properly carves microphone with parameters: sensitivity, frequency response, polar pattern, impedance, and power. States the persistence mechanism (diaphragm and transducer element). Law 4 compliant.
Definition properly carves digital audio with parameters: sample rate, bit depth. States the persistence mechanism (numerical samples encoding amplitude at specific time points). Law 4 compliant.

A codec (coder-decoder) is a specific algorithmic procedure for compressing and decompressing data. 'Is codec an instance of algorithm?' Yes — a competent speaker would call a codec 'an algorithm.' The removal of algorithm as a category doesn't make codec stop operating; the kind-membership test passes.

payload.note: Buffer underrun is the condition where a buffer empties before new data arrives — the concept only operates by reference to buffer size as the threshold parameter. Remove buffer-size and the underrun condition has no reference for 'too small,' ceasing to operate.

Latency compensation operates by buffering and compensating timing variations through jitter buffers. Remove jitter buffers and the latency compensation mechanism has no operational substrate — it ceases to function as designed.
